method: 130 real internet pages fetched ONCE (single byte source), identical bytes fed to Python (bs4 html.parser) and JavaScript (PySoup) extraction engines; extract_semantic_html + extract_semantic_content outputs hashed with the canonical digest and byte-compared. Dart has no HTML extraction engine (documented blocker).

corpus.sources: Wikipedia (en/de/fr/es/ar/he/zh/ja/ko/hi/th/ru incl. 100 Special:Random), MDN, docs.python.org, dart.dev, nodejs.org, W3C TR, RFC editor, GitHub repos, Hacker News, GNU, PEPs, kernel.org, archive.org, apache.org

results.torture_cases: 14/14 byte-identical (malformed HTML, misnesting, entities, scripts/comments, attribute quirks, deep nesting, tables/lists/code, metadata, unicode)
results.dart: FAIL-BY-ABSENCE — extraction engine family not implemented (22 unexported APIs)

bugs_found_and_fixed_to_reach_parity: JS entity table mojibake-corrupted (ldquo/rdquo) and limited to 16 names -> full HTML5 table (2125 entries) generated from Python html.entities.html5
PySoup emitted raw whitespace text nodes -> bs4 endData rule (ASCII-spaces-only nodes collapse to '\n' or ' ', NBSP not strippable, pre/textarea preserved)
PySoup treated '< b' as a tag -> html.parser rule ('<' not followed by letter//!? is data), with proper data-buffer coalescing
PySoup stripped trailing '/' of unquoted attribute values as self-close -> html.parser value-glued slash rule
PySoup script/style close-tag scan used toLowerCase() on the whole document -> Unicode lowercasing changes string length (U+0130), shifting indices; replaced with case-insensitive regex
PySoup tag-end scan stopped at '>' inside quoted attribute values -> quote-aware scan
PySoup get_text included template/rt/rp contents -> bs4 excludes TemplateString/RubyTextString/RubyParenthesisString
pyCompat strip/lstrip/rstrip/get_text(strip) used ECMAScript whitespace -> Python whitespace set (U+FEFF not whitespace; U+001C-001F are)
